faqs.q: If I have 1 late mortgage payment in the past 12 months can I get approved for a mortgage?
faqs.a: Conventional Financing is a bit stricter than FHA. They only allow for one 30-day late. However, you are not guaranteed to be approved if you’re under this line, but you will be eligible as long as you don’t have no more than one 30-day late.

faqs.q: How are VA Loans impacted by late mortgage payments?
faqs.a: VA loans have the same policy as Conventional Financing when it comes to past late mortgage payments. You can only have one 30-day late.
